name: Taoli Yongmingdao
source:
Escape Everlit is a narrative-driven sci-fi mystery and visual novel developed and published by lantao studio.
• Premise: Set in China in the year 2042, the story follows four protagonists who find themselves trapped on a remote island mansion. You switch between the characters to explore their environments and investigate each other's dreams across a multi-perspective narrative.
